T: Eleven hours. One very hungry man.
D: A retired special forces colonel has eleven hours to get his kidnapped daughter back from a deposed dictator's island hideout.
P: Serve the starters when Matrix asks the stewardess not to disturb his friend.
S: Jenny's sandwich: you don't wanna know.

Fry the bacon until crisp and toast the bread. Stir the mayo with the sriracha and relish for the secret sauce. Build triple-deckers: sauce, turkey and lettuce, then toast, then bacon, avocado and tomato. Pin with toothpicks and cut each into 4 triangles.
Let off some steam pork buns
Braised pork belly in steamed buns with pickles. Let off some steam, Bennett.

Brown the pork belly all over in a heavy pot. Add the soy, hoisin, sugar, garlic, ginger and water, cover and simmer gently until tender. Lift out the pork, reduce the liquid to a sticky glaze and slice the pork thickly into it. Toss the cucumber with the rice vinegar and a pinch of sugar, and steam the buns. Fill the buns with pork, cucumber, peanuts and coriander.
M: Citrus and garlic mojo chicken grilled with rice. Arius wants him back in Val Verde.

Mix the citrus juice, garlic, cumin, oregano, oil and salt and marinate the chicken for at least 2 hours. Roast the chicken at 200C, skin side up, until crisp and cooked through, basting with the marinade. Soften the onion and capsicum, add the beans with their liquid and simmer until thick. Cook the rice and serve with the chicken, beans and coriander.
1.2kg chicken thighs, bone in, skin on@Meat
Green Berets for breakfast huevos rancheros
Eggs, salsa and beans on tortillas. Matrix eats Green Berets for breakfast.

Soften the onion and garlic in a little oil, add the tomatoes and chipotle and simmer to a thick salsa. Warm the beans and fry the tortillas in a little oil until just crisp at the edges. Fry the eggs sunny side up in the rest of the oil. Spread beans on the tortillas, add the eggs and spoon the salsa round, then top with feta, green chilli and avocado.
W: I let him go tres leches
Sponge soaked in three milks under whipped cream. He let Sully go.

Beat the yolks with 150g sugar until pale, then stir in the milk and fold in the flour. Whisk the whites with the rest of the sugar to soft peaks and fold through. Bake in a lined 20 by 30cm tin at 175C until springy. Prick the warm cake all over and pour over the condensed milk, evaporated milk and coconut cream, mixed. Chill overnight. Whip the cream and spread over, then finish with lime zest and coconut.
K: Fly or die seaplane rum punch
Rum, pineapple, lime and grenadine punch. The seaplane gets up: fly or die.
Stir the rum, pineapple, lime and grenadine in a jug. Pour into 4 tall glasses of ice and top with soda. Grate a little nutmeg over each.
